items.finding: Additionally, the temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary.
items.how_it_applies: Since temperature strongly affects water absorption bands in aqueous dairy streams, monitoring product temperature closely or using temperature-controlled flow cells should be tested to maintain calibration stability.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The source discusses general aqueous solutions and MIR/NIR instrument configurations, which may differ from the specific concentrated milk product matrix and flow cell design used here.
